name: Gear Roadmap
description: A consensus Ironman equipment progression with a compact core and explicitly optional RNG or playstyle branches.

sources.title: Yazi's Ironman Gear Progression 2025
sources.notes: Modern milestone and loadout reference; factual item and activity relationships only.

sources.title: OSRS Wiki Ironman guide
sources.notes: Current mid-game alternatives and Barrows/Moons/Slayer context.

sources.title: ironman.guide gear progression
sources.notes: Cross-style early, mid, late, and endgame item coverage.

sources.title: Ladlor's Interactive Gear Progression Chart
sources.notes: Efficient sequencing reference. Iron Compass does not reproduce its chart or source data.

sources.title: Ironman gear progression checklist — not a strict order
sources.notes: Used to identify optionality, modern bridge content, and low-priority grinds.

steps.title: Dragon scimitar or stronger melee weapon
steps.instruction: Establish a dependable general-purpose melee weapon; later melee upgrades also satisfy this milestone.
steps.reason: It is the standard early melee baseline and remains useful until a Zombie axe, whip, raid weapon, or equivalent takes over.

steps.title: Dragon defender
steps.instruction: Reach the basement cyclopes and obtain a Dragon defender.
steps.reason: This is a durable offensive off-hand and the direct foundation for the Avernic defender.

steps.title: Barrows gloves
steps.instruction: Finish Recipe for Disaster for the universal early-to-late combat glove.
steps.reason: Barrows gloves cover all three styles and avoid early clue or boss RNG for a high-value slot.

completion.label: Barrows gloves or later combat gloves

steps.title: Helm of Neitiznot
steps.instruction: Obtain the Helm of Neitiznot or a later strength-focused helmet.
steps.reason: It is cheap, quest-gated rather than RNG-gated, and remains a strong general melee helm for a long time.

steps.title: Fighter torso or strength body
steps.instruction: Obtain a Fighter torso, or let a later strength body satisfy this slot naturally.
steps.reason: The torso supplies lasting melee strength without a long drop grind, but Moons, Bandos, Torva, and Oathplate are valid later replacements.

steps.title: Practical ranged weapon
steps.instruction: Secure a Rune crossbow, Magic shortbow (i), Hunters' sunlight crossbow, or a later ranged weapon.
steps.reason: These weapons cover early questing and boss mechanics without demanding a single mandatory ranged path.

steps.title: Ava's accumulator
steps.instruction: Complete Animal Magnetism and upgrade the device when Vorkath becomes available.
steps.reason: Ava's devices conserve ammunition and provide the default ranged cape progression.

steps.title: Iban's staff (u) or powered upgrade
steps.instruction: Upgrade Iban's staff, then replace it only when Warped, Titans, Slayer, or boss progression supports the change.
steps.reason: It gives an Ironman a strong, accessible spell before powered staves become practical.

completion.label: Iban's staff (u) or stronger magic weapon

steps.title: God cape
steps.instruction: Complete Mage Arena I for a God cape; its imbued form also satisfies this milestone.
steps.reason: This is a fast, deterministic magic-damage cape upgrade with no drop grind.

steps.title: Fire cape
steps.instruction: Complete the Fight Caves once the account has comfortable supplies and ranged gear.
steps.reason: The cape is a major permanent melee upgrade and a useful first PvM execution milestone.

steps.title: Imbued Slayer helmet
steps.instruction: Build and imbue a Slayer helmet as the Black mask progression becomes available.
steps.reason: Its on-task bonuses scale across melee, ranged, and magic and make Slayer a central equipment engine.

steps.title: Amulet of glory
steps.instruction: Reach an Amulet of glory through Crafting, Hunter, or another reliable Ironman method.
steps.reason: It is the first broadly useful combat necklace and a stepping stone to Fury and Zenyte jewellery.

steps.title: Berserker ring (i) or late-game ring
steps.instruction: Add a meaningful combat ring when Dagannoth Kings are comfortable, or let a later raid or DT2 ring replace the grind.
steps.reason: The strength bonus is valuable, but this slot should not halt broader account progression if Rex is poorly timed.

steps.title: Imbued God cape
steps.instruction: Complete Mage Arena II for one imbued God cape.
steps.reason: It is the lasting pre-endgame magic cape and does not depend on boss-table RNG.

steps.title: Dragon boots
steps.instruction: Obtain Dragon boots at 83 Slayer, or count their upgraded descendants.
steps.reason: They are a straightforward strength-slot upgrade on the Slayer path and feed directly into Primordial boots or Avernic treads.

steps.title: Abyssal whip or stronger melee weapon
steps.instruction: Use the Slayer, raid, or boss path to move beyond the early melee weapon tier.
steps.reason: This milestone marks the transition from quest-shop weapons to durable mid- and late-game melee damage.

steps.title: Powered staff progression
steps.instruction: Move from Iban's staff into a Warped sceptre, Trident, or stronger powered magic weapon.
steps.reason: A powered staff makes magic damage scale cleanly with levels and unlocks efficient bossing and raids.

steps.title: First Zenyte jewellery
steps.instruction: Craft the first Zenyte piece that best supports the account's current content.
steps.reason: The first Zenyte is a major account milestone; its exact order should follow content preference rather than a rigid universal sequence.

steps.title: Zombie axe bridge
steps.instruction: Use the Zombie axe as an accessible slash/crush bridge when it improves the content you want to do.
steps.reason: It is powerful before a whip or raid weapon, but an efficient Slayer or Gauntlet path can reasonably pass it.

steps.title: Barrows tank body and legs
steps.instruction: Target useful tank pieces rather than treating completion of every Barrows set as mandatory.
steps.reason: Tank armour smooths Moons and other mid-game PvM, but specific drops can take hundreds of chests and should remain optional.

steps.title: Blood Moon set
steps.instruction: Build the Blood Moon armour set when melee strength gear and its set effect support your plans.
steps.reason: Moons provides a strong supply-positive bridge, but efficient Bowfa-focused routes may skip finishing the set.

steps.title: Eclipse Moon set
steps.instruction: Build the Eclipse Moon armour set when the hybrid ranged/melee niche fits your bossing plans.
steps.reason: It is a capable bridge for several bosses, without being a universal prerequisite for Bowfa or raids.

steps.title: Blue Moon set
steps.instruction: Build the Blue Moon armour set when a magic bridge is more useful than waiting for Ahrim, Virtus, or Ancestral pieces.
steps.reason: It is accessible and useful, but duplicate-protected Moons completion is still a chosen side path rather than a hard gate.

steps.title: Twinflame staff from Royal Titans
steps.instruction: Pursue the Twinflame staff if Royal Titans and multi-target magic fit the current plan.
steps.reason: Royal Titans also offer valuable prayers, but those unlocks are not equipment and are intentionally left to the main progression route.

steps.title: Bowfa and Crystal armour branch
steps.instruction: Complete a Bow of Faerdhinen setup when the Corrupted Gauntlet route matches your goals and tolerance for the grind.
steps.reason: Bowfa is a major account turning point and an efficient route backbone, but community consensus does not make an immediate rush mandatory for every player.

steps.title: Ava's assembler
steps.instruction: Complete Dragon Slayer II and obtain Vorkath's head for Ava's assembler.
steps.reason: It is a deterministic ranged max-hit and accuracy upgrade after the quest and remains useful through endgame.

steps.title: Toxic blowpipe
steps.instruction: Add a Toxic blowpipe for healing, special attacks, and short-range damage roles.
steps.reason: Bowfa does not remove the blowpipe's utility; the two weapons cover different encounters and phases.

steps.title: Raid-tier melee weapon
steps.instruction: Secure Osmumten's fang or another raid-tier general melee weapon.
steps.reason: High-accuracy melee opens tougher bosses and higher-invocation raids without requiring a megarare first.

steps.title: Defence-reduction special weapon
steps.instruction: Obtain a Dragon warhammer, Bandos godsword, or Elder maul for team and solo boss defence reduction.
steps.reason: One reliable defence-reduction option has more account value than insisting on one particular rare drop.

steps.title: Late-game strength body and legs
steps.instruction: Build a Bandos, Torva, or Oathplate-strength body-and-leg pairing.
steps.reason: This is the durable melee armour transition after torso and Moons; upgraded descendants count automatically.

steps.title: Amulet of torture or rancour
steps.instruction: Complete the dedicated melee necklace slot with Torture or its later replacement.
steps.reason: After a first flexible Zenyte, the melee necklace is a consistent upgrade for Slayer, bosses, and raids.

steps.title: Avernic defender
steps.instruction: Upgrade the Dragon defender once Theatre of Blood is a stable part of the account's PvM.
steps.reason: It is a permanent melee off-hand upgrade and a clean endpoint for the core equipment roadmap.

steps.title: Tormented Demons weapon branch
steps.instruction: Choose Emberlight, Scorching bow, Purging staff, or Burning claws according to the content that benefits first.
steps.reason: These are powerful targeted upgrades, but their value depends on the bosses and styles the player wants to prioritize.

steps.title: Complete Zenyte jewellery set
steps.instruction: Finish Suffering, Anguish, Torture, and Tormented bracelet as the account's Crafting and Demonic Gorilla grind mature.
steps.reason: All four are valuable, but forcing one universal crafting order would ignore the player's current raid and boss priorities.

steps.title: Infernal cape
steps.instruction: Pursue the Inferno when execution skill, supplies, and ranged gear make the learning process worthwhile.
steps.reason: It is a major prestige and melee upgrade, but not a prerequisite for continuing raids or most account progression.

steps.title: Dizana's quiver
steps.instruction: Complete the Fortis Colosseum when the account and player are ready for the execution challenge.
steps.reason: The quiver is an exceptional ranged upgrade, but its challenge should not block unrelated gear branches.

steps.title: Doom of Mokhaiotl upgrades
steps.instruction: Add Eye of Ayak, Confliction gauntlets, or Avernic treads after the core style foundations are already strong.
steps.reason: These are powerful modern upgrades, but source consensus places them after broader weapons, jewellery, and prayer foundations.

steps.title: Oathplate armour set
steps.instruction: Build Oathplate or Radiant Oathplate when Yama progression fits the account's preferred endgame path.
steps.reason: It is a powerful modern armour branch, not a universal reason to delay raids or other upgrades.

steps.title: Forgotten Four ring branch
steps.instruction: Choose the DT2 ring whose style most improves current content rather than grinding all four immediately.
steps.reason: Ultor, Magus, Venator, and Bellator are long style-specific grinds with no single universal first choice.

steps.title: Fortified Masori set
steps.instruction: Complete fortified Masori as Tombs of Amascut and Armadyl components arrive naturally.
steps.reason: It is the endgame ranged-armour branch, but raid RNG should not define the only valid next goal.

steps.title: Ancestral armour set
steps.instruction: Complete Ancestral as Chambers of Xeric rewards arrive; use interim magic armour without treating it as failure.
steps.reason: Ancestral is an endgame magic target with substantial raid RNG, so it remains a tracked branch rather than a gate.

steps.title: Endgame melee armour set
steps.instruction: Complete a Torva, Oathplate, or Radiant Oathplate three-piece endgame armour setup.
steps.reason: Nex and Yama provide alternative endgame armour paths; mixed equivalent slot upgrades are accepted.

steps.title: Twisted bow
steps.instruction: Treat the Twisted bow as a transformative raid reward, not as a prerequisite for enjoying endgame PvM.
steps.reason: It is a megarare endpoint whose timing is controlled by raid RNG rather than a sensible fixed checklist position.

steps.title: Tumeken's shadow
steps.instruction: Treat Tumeken's shadow as a transformative raid reward rather than a gate before other content.
steps.reason: Its acquisition is a long RNG branch, and the roadmap should keep useful non-megarare upgrades visible.

steps.title: Scythe of vitur
steps.instruction: Treat the Scythe as the Theatre of Blood melee endpoint, not a universal prerequisite.
steps.reason: It is encounter-dependent, expensive to use, and governed by raid RNG despite its enormous ceiling.

steps.title: Soulflame horn
steps.instruction: Add the Soulflame horn when Yama and the encounters that reward its niche are already part of the account's plans.
steps.reason: It is a specialized endgame upgrade and should not reorder the broader core roadmap by itself.
